summary: International General Insurance Holdings Ltd. (IGI) filed a Form 6-K on September 1, 2026, to announce the launch of Cipher Underwriting Ltd., a Bermuda-based specialty treaty reinsurance MGA focused on cyber risks. IGI owns a 60% interest through its subsidiary IGI Managing Agencies Holdings Ltd. Operations are subject to Bermuda Monetary Authority approvals. The launch is a business expansion, not a special situation like an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The filing is a routine current report for a new venture without strategic or capital markets event implications.
